ideas.pitch: A rapid prototyping dashboard with built-in accessibility linter, automated semantic DOM tagging, and performance auditing designed specifically to maximize scores against the FAIE automated evaluation engine.
ideas.title: FAIE-Ready UI Component Sandbox
ideas.why_it_could_win: Since the evaluation is entirely automated via the FAIE Engine focusing on accessibility, performance, and structure, optimizing directly for machine-readable UI compliance ensures maximum possible points.

ideas.pitch: A solo frontend debugging utility that runs automated multi-viewport snapshots and semantic layout regression tests on a 3-chance feedback loop, letting solo devs patch CSS bugs before submitting.
ideas.title: DOM-Diff Visual Regression Studio
ideas.why_it_could_win: With 3 distinct chances to improve your score via the automated engine, having a rapid local regression and visual diff testing workflow directly targets the competition's scoring mechanic.

ideas.pitch: A high-performance, ultra-accessible component library built for 6-hour hackathon constraints, featuring fully keyboard-navigable ARIA primitives and zero layout-shift styling.
ideas.title: Micro-Interaction Design System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Automated scoring engines heavily weigh accessibility and visual quality metrics; shipping a pre-tested, hyper-accessible primitive set guarantees high rubric marks.

ideas.pitch: A plug-and-play local-first state persistence and error-boundary wrapper that automatically logs performance telemetry and DOM exceptions for instant debugging.
ideas.title: Instant State-Persist Frontend Shell
ideas.why_it_could_win: Scoring criteria prioritize code quality, structure, and documentation; a clean, observable frontend wrapper minimizes runtime exceptions and maximizes automated reliability scores.

ideas.pitch: A zero-config tool that scans your React component tree, extracts prop types, generates interactive live previews, and outputs a complete FAIE-compliant project documentation bundle.
ideas.title: Automated Docs & README Generator for Frontend
ideas.why_it_could_win: Project documentation is explicitly listed as a core evaluation criterion for the automated FAIE engine, making automated doc generation a high-yield feature to include.
